kajjala: kajjala [Sk. kajjala, dial. fr. kad+jala, from jalati, jval, orig. burning badly or dimly, a dirty burn] lamp--black or soot, used as a collyrium Vin II.50 (read k. for kapalla, cp. J.P.T.S. 1887, 167).
kajjopakkamaka: kajjopakkamaka a kind of gem Miln 118 (vajira k. phussarāga lohitanka).
